priceNote: Jun 23 · ↑5% today · BlueBird launch hype · Blue Origin recovery predicted H2 2026 · Barclays cut PT to $60
summary: ASTS down from $79 to $73 as Barclays cut PT further to $60 (Underweight) and the stock continues fading from its $133 ATH. BlueBird 8/9/10 are successfully in orbit (Jun 17), and Blue Origin says it can resume launches by end-2026 — mitigating the key risk. Japan J-LEO award (Q3 2026) remains the binary catalyst that could reprice this stock by ±40%. Size is ค่าขนม only — no revenue, binary outcome.

catalysts.name: BlueBird 8/9/10 — In Orbit ✅
catalysts.description: SpaceX Falcon 9 launched Jun 17 successfully. Nearly 2× peak data speeds vs Block 1. Commercial constellation now at ~10 satellites; target 45–60 by end-2026.

catalysts.name: Japan J-LEO Award — Binary Event
catalysts.description: Multi-billion JPY contract with Rakuten / NTT Docomo. Decision expected Q3 2026. Win = +40%+, miss = -25%. Only reason to hold through the summer.

catalysts.name: Blue Origin Recovery — H2 2026
catalysts.description: Jeff Bezos confirmed Blue Origin can resume New Glenn launches by end-2026. Relieves the biggest near-term concern: future ASTS satellite block launches via Blue Origin vehicle.

risks: Blue Origin New Glenn explosion (May 29) — delays Block 3+ satellite launches; Q4 2026 timeline uncertain
Barclays Underweight PT $60 (cut from $65 on Jun 22) — latest analyst is bearish, valuation at $28B for pre-revenue company
Deutsche Bank downgraded to Hold PT $106 (Jun 9) — post-explosion thesis revision
No revenue yet — burn rate increasing; potential equity raise at $65–75 range would be dilutive
SpaceX Starlink T-Mobile direct competition — 300+ satellite head start, faster scaling
Japan J-LEO binary risk — miss = -25% from current levels
Satellite manufacturing yield — scaling from 10 to 45+ satellites untested at this speed

catalystSpot.preRunup: ASTS has a pattern of massive pre-launch runs — BB2-7 ran from $10 → $27 (+170%) before launch. BB8-10 ran from $65 → $80+ pre-launch. Japan J-LEO rumor/pre-announcement could generate a similar run in Q3 before the official decision.

postWin.note: BB1 Apr 2024 → stock ran +200% in 2 weeks post-launch. BB2-7 Sep 2024 → +192% overall. Japan J-LEO win estimated +40%+ day-of based on Rakuten contract scale.

postLose.note: Blue Origin explosion May 29, 2026 → ASTS -18% in 1 day. Japan J-LEO miss expected -25%+ given no revenue to cushion.

spotSizing.reason: SPECULATIVE / ค่าขนม — binary Japan J-LEO outcome, Barclays PT $60 implies -17% downside from current, no revenue. Max 3% of portfolio. Can re-size to 5% if Japan win is confirmed.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Break below $62 before Japan award = institutional selling, low probability of win. Reduce exposure early.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Japan misses or commercial activation delayed → exit within 1 trading session. ASTS has no revenue to cushion downside.
